SELECT SUM(IF(last_time IS NULL,1,0)) AS 0_day, SUM(IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, IFNULL(last_time,create_time), NOW())>=7,1,0)) AS 7_day, SUM(IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, IFNULL(last_time,create_time), NOW())>=15,1,0)) AS 15_day, SUM(IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, IFNULL(last_time,create_time), NOW())>=30,1,0)) AS 30_day, SUM(IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, IFNULL(last_time,create_time), NOW())>=3,1,0)) AS 3_month, SUM(IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, IFNULL(last_time,create_time), NOW())>=6,1,0)) AS 6_month FROM ( SELECT MAX(pc.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(f.create_time) AS last_time FROM crm_pre_customer pc LEFT JOIN crm_on_follow_rel fr ON pc.module_id = fr.module_id AND pc.id = fr.rel_data_id LEFT JOIN crm_on_follow f ON fr.rel_module_id = f.module_id AND fr.data_id = f.id WHERE pc.create_time > #{biDTO.startTime} AND pc.create_time < #{biDTO.endTime} AND pc.del_flag = 1
AND pc.scope_org_id IN
AND pc.create_user_id IN
#{dataId}
GROUP BY pc.id ) u

SELECT module_id, create_time AS date_time, IFNULL(real_money,0) AS value FROM crm_on_contract WHERE create_time > #{biDTO.startTime} AND create_time < #{biDTO.endTime} AND del_flag = 1
AND scope_org_id IN
AND create_user_id IN
#{dataId}

SELECT SUM(real_money) real_money FROM crm_on_contract WHERE create_time > #{biDTO.startTime} AND create_time < #{biDTO.endTime} AND del_flag = 1
AND scope_org_id IN
AND create_user_id IN
#{dataId}

SELECT scope_user_id AS id, SUM(real_money) AS value FROM crm_on_contract WHERE create_time > #{biDTO.startTime} AND create_time < #{biDTO.endTime} AND del_flag = 1
AND scope_org_id IN
AND scope_user_id IN
#{dataId}
GROUP BY scope_user_id ORDER BY name DESC LIMIT 10
